decisions.reason: GA4 is Google's mandatory analytics standard, so the plugin meets ongoing client demand and fits the firm's analytics bundle at low maintenance cost, well above aspiration.
Universal Analytics has been fully shut down by Google, so the plugin has no remaining use and falls far below aspiration; its developer capacity is better shifted to GA4 and integration work.
The retail system interface builds on the firm's core integration skills and supports shop projects, so carrying it costs little while its results mature, using the slack of a growing industry.
Relaunch SEO support is a labor-based service with little fixed cost that complements the firm's core relaunch business and has its own page, which suggests it meets aspirations.
SEO workshops are a new, low-cost extension of the firm's marketing expertise with their own page, and their uncertain early results do not justify dropping them yet given modest resource demands.
